links.outcome: AI performance across four hospital sites
links.effect: Cases from four hospital systems (Shenzhen, Zhengzhou, Shijiazhuang, Jinan) evaluated; pooled NPV 98.80% for ASC-H+; sensitivity 90.77%. Site-specific results not shown in the abstract.
links.quote: The authors used the Ruiqian WSI-2400 (with the registered trademark AICyte) to evaluate a collection of 163,848 original cervical cytology cases from 2018 to 2023 that were collected from four different hospital systems in China.

links.outcome: Missed lesions among cases AI labeled negative and not needing review
links.effect: 49 LSIL+ cases were designated by AICyte as not needing further review; NPV 98.80% for ASC-H+ and 99.94% for LSIL+. Follow-up found 8 CIN1 and 18 negative cases; the rest had no histology.
links.quote: Of the 49 low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion or higher that were designed by AICyte as not needing further review, the cytohistologic correlation revealed eight cases of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia 1 and 18 negative cases; and the remaining cases were without histologic follow-up.

unlisted_practices: Using AI alone as an independent screener with a 50% negative cutoff to finalize negative cervical cytology cases without human review
